authenticationClasses.description: Public endpoint; no credential is sent.
connectors: public state and county GIS or property-record endpoints

authenticationClasses.description: The government or data provider requires its own API key or token. Cloud Run retrieves only the named credential from Secret Manager at runtime.
The provider requires an identifying username, email, or user-agent header. These values are provider-specific and are not Google service-account credentials.
Furlong-owned cryptographic material used for attestation, not external-provider authentication.

Reserved exception class for a state or agency that mandates OAuth/OIDC, a client certificate, IP allowlisting, or a legacy login. Each exception requires provider documentation, least privilege, and an approved rotation/revocation runbook.
